title: King of the World
description: A young man stands at the bow of a massive ocean liner at sunset, arms spread wide, shouting that he is king of the world as the ship cuts through the Atlantic.

title: T-Rex Breakout
description: During a thunderstorm at night, the electric fences fail and a Tyrannosaurus rex escapes its paddock, attacking two stranded tour vehicles while children hide inside.

title: Red Pill or Blue Pill
description: In a rain-soaked abandoned building, a mysterious man in dark sunglasses offers a hacker a choice between two pills: one lets him forget everything, the other reveals the truth about reality.

title: Bullet Time Rooftop
description: On a rooftop, a man in a long black coat bends backwards in slow motion as bullets ripple past him, dodging gunfire from an agent in a suit.

title: The Spinning Top
description: A man returns home to his children after years away and spins a small metal top on the table, walking away before the audience learns whether it falls or keeps spinning in a dream.

title: Hallway Fight in Zero Gravity
description: Two men brawl inside a hotel corridor as gravity shifts and the hallway rotates, throwing them against walls, floor and ceiling in a weightless fight.

title: Why So Serious
description: A clown-faced criminal with smeared makeup corners a mob boss at a party and tells the story of how he got his scars, holding a knife to his victim's mouth.

title: Truck Flip Chase
description: A night-time chase through downtown streets ends with an armored vehicle and an eighteen-wheeler truck flipping end over end as a caped vigilante races past on a motorcycle.

title: I Am Your Father
movie: Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back
description: A young warrior clings to a gantry over a bottomless shaft in a cloud city after losing his hand in a lightsaber duel, while a masked villain in black armor reveals he is his father.

title: Opening Crawl and Star Destroyer
description: Yellow text scrolls into deep space, then a small rebel ship is pursued by an enormous triangular imperial warship that fills the screen as it passes overhead.

title: Shower Scene
description: A woman showers in a roadside motel bathroom when a shadowy figure pulls back the curtain and attacks her with a knife to the sound of shrieking violins.

title: Here's Johnny
description: A deranged husband hacks through a bathroom door with an axe in a snowbound hotel while his terrified wife screams and clutches a kitchen knife, then he grins through the hole.

title: Chestburster at Dinner
description: A spaceship crew laughs over a meal until one of them convulses in pain and a small alien creature bursts out of his chest, spraying blood across the table.

title: Diner Conversation
description: A veteran detective and a master thief sit across from each other in a late-night coffee shop, calmly discussing their lives and admitting they will kill each other if they have to.

title: Downtown Bank Shootout
description: A bank robbery goes wrong and the crew fights its way through crowded city streets in broad daylight with assault rifles, shattering car windows as police return fire.

title: Royale with Cheese
description: Two hitmen in black suits drive to a job and chat about what fast food hamburgers are called in Europe, mixing casual humor with the menace of what they are about to do.

title: Twist Contest
description: A gangster's wife drags a reluctant hitman onto the dance floor of a retro fifties-themed restaurant where they perform a deadpan twist routine barefoot.

title: Storming Omaha Beach
description: Landing craft ramps drop and soldiers are cut down by machine gun fire as they wade through blood-red surf onto a heavily defended beach in Normandy on D-Day.

title: Arena Battle
description: A former general turned slave leads fellow gladiators against chariots in a dusty colosseum, then removes his helmet and reveals his identity to the emperor, asking if the crowd is entertained.

title: Toy Dinosaur and the Claw
description: A cowboy doll and a space ranger action figure fall into a claw machine at a pizza arcade surrounded by squeaky three-eyed alien toys who worship the mechanical claw.

title: Finding Dory Reunion
description: A clownfish father searching the ocean for his lost son meets a forgetful blue tang fish who offers to help, speaking whale and swimming through a jellyfish forest.

title: Married Life Montage
description: A wordless montage follows a couple from their wedding through decades of ordinary life, a lost pregnancy, saving coins in a jar for a trip, and finally a hospital goodbye.

title: Docking with the Endurance
description: A pilot manually spins a small shuttle to match the rotation of a damaged space station tumbling above a planet, docking against impossible odds as an organ score swells.

title: Giant Wave on Miller's Planet
description: Astronauts wade through shallow water on an alien ocean planet when what looked like distant mountains turns out to be a mile-high tidal wave bearing down on their ship.

title: Fury Road Sandstorm
description: A convoy of war rigs and spiked muscle cars races across a desert wasteland straight into a towering electrical sandstorm, vehicles exploding and lightning tearing through the dust.

title: Stairs Dance
description: A man in a red suit with green hair and clown makeup dances down a long outdoor concrete staircase in a run-down city neighborhood, celebrating his transformation.

title: Portals Assemble
description: A battered hero stands alone on a ruined battlefield facing an alien army until glowing orange portals open behind him and every superhero returns for a final charge.

title: The Snap
description: A purple titan wearing a golden gauntlet with six glowing stones snaps his fingers, and heroes across the world dissolve into drifting ash in silence.

title: Bus Jump
description: A city bus rigged with a bomb that explodes if it slows below fifty miles per hour accelerates toward a gap in an unfinished freeway and jumps across it.

title: Rooftop Jump Barefoot
description: A barefoot cop in a dirty tank top ties a fire hose around his waist and leaps off the roof of a skyscraper as explosions erupt behind him on Christmas Eve.

title: Boulder Escape
description: An archaeologist in a fedora swaps a golden idol for a bag of sand in a jungle temple, triggering traps and a giant rolling boulder that chases him out of the cave.

title: Flying Bicycles
description: Children on BMX bikes flee government agents through suburban streets until a small alien in the basket lifts them into the sky, silhouetted against a full moon.

title: Clock Tower Lightning
description: A wild-haired scientist dangles from a town clock tower in a storm, reconnecting a cable so a lightning bolt can power a silver sports car time machine racing down the street.

title: Vertigo Scene in the Lift
description: A spy climbs the glass exterior of the world's tallest skyscraper in Dubai using electronic adhesive gloves that start to fail hundreds of floors above the ground.

title: You Can't Handle the Truth
description: In a military courtroom, a young navy lawyer badgers a decorated colonel on the witness stand until the colonel explodes and angrily admits he ordered the illegal punishment.

title: Fake Orgasm at the Deli
description: A woman loudly fakes an orgasm in a crowded New York delicatessen to win an argument, and an older customer at the next table tells the waiter she will have what she is having.

title: Boombox Serenade
description: A heartbroken teenager in a trench coat stands outside his ex-girlfriend's bedroom window at dawn holding a boombox over his head, playing their song.

title: Kiss in the Rain
description: A couple reunites on a wooden dock during a downpour, arguing about the letters he wrote her every day for a year before kissing passionately in the rain.

title: Tunnel Escape in the Rain
description: A wrongly convicted banker crawls through a sewage pipe out of prison and emerges in a creek during a thunderstorm, tearing off his shirt and raising his arms to the rain.

title: Horse Head in the Bed
description: A Hollywood movie producer wakes in his silk-sheeted bed to find it soaked in blood and discovers the severed head of his prized racehorse under the covers.

title: Spider-Man Train Rescue
description: A masked hero shoots webs to the sides of a runaway elevated train and strains with his whole body to stop it before it plunges off the end of the track.

title: Dance Off at Prom
description: A struggling actress and a jazz pianist tap dance together on a hillside overlooking the purple Los Angeles skyline at twilight, pretending not to be attracted to each other.

title: Dinosaur Kitchen Hunt
description: Two children hide among steel counters in an industrial kitchen as a pair of velociraptors stalk them, clicking their claws on the tiled floor and opening doors.

title: Hallelujah Courtroom Dog
description: A bubbly law student in a pink suit wins a murder trial by exposing a witness's lie about getting a perm and showering the same day, delighting the courtroom.

title: Desert Chase on Camelback
description: A spice harvester crew flees across endless orange dunes as a colossal sandworm surfaces beneath them, swallowing the machine whole while an ornithopter hovers above.

title: Chariot Race
description: Rival princes whip their horse teams around a massive Roman circus in a brutal chariot race, wheels shattering and drivers dragged through the sand before roaring crowds.

title: Lion Cub Presentation
description: At sunrise over the African savanna, animals gather at the foot of a giant rock as a wise baboon lifts a newborn lion cub high for all the kingdom to see.

title: Ice Skating Dance
description: A queen with ice powers flees up a snowy mountain and builds a glittering castle of ice from nothing while singing about finally letting go of her fear.
